Team —

Quick nudge as finance closes the week: I ran the weekly SFDC extract and attached a short opportunites-aging CSV (opps_aging_q4.csv). A few asks so we can lock the Q4 forecast by EOD Friday: 

- Please confirm owner and committed stage for any open opportunity > 60 days in the pipeline. Mark one of: Commit / Upside / Disqualified.
- Update close date if the current date is older than 30 days from your last contact. If date is accurate, add a one-line note in the "OwnerNote" field (example: "Verbal POC 10/22 - legal review 2w").
- If a deal is ready to drop from the forecast, set Stage = Disqualified and add the reason. Finance will exclude Disqualified from coverage.

I created a tiny action matrix in Drive (ownership_matrix.xlsx) to track quick handbacks: owner / deal id / ask / due. Put a single line per opp.

Target: pull final numbers Friday 5pm PT. If you need help triaging anything high-dollar, reply-all and tag me — I will jump in.

Attachments: opps_aging_q4.csv (CSV export, 42 rows)

Thanks,
Evelyn
